funding.quote: The allocation of Graduate Research Scholarships by the Faculty of Medicine, Dentistry and Health Sciences (MDHS) is subject to approval by the faculty selection committee. | International students may also receive Overseas Student Health Cover and a tuition fee offset.

also.quote: A fortnightly stipend with a rate of $41,100 per year pro rata (2027 full-time rate) for up to two years for students undertaking a Masters by Research degree or up to 3.5 years for students undertaking a doctoral degree. | The Melbourne Research Scholarship is offered to students who are ranked highest by relevant selection panels

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's with a research component of at least 25% of a full-time year and a final-year average of at least 80%, or a master's with such a research component and an 80% average; a research proposal is also required.
entry_route.quote: a four-year bachelor degree in a relevant discipline which includes a substantial research component equivalent to at least 25% of one year of full-time study and have achieved a minimum weighted average of 80% in the final year subjects or (University of Melbourne) equivalent; | a masters degree in a relevant discipline which includes a substantial research component equivalent to at least 25% of one year of full-time study and achieved a minimum weighted average of 80% or (University of Melbourne) equivalent;
